system.description:
The healers of the Cabal's oldest seat, the Nalwood under Arikh Evergreen, and the circles that learned from it.

  • Forest Vigour: reroll 1s on the healing dice of spells you cast.
    • 9th level: your healing spells also restore +1 HP per die.
  • Ancient Lore: Advantage on Nature Lore checks in old-growth forest, without designating it as a trained region.
